doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Carter band sidemen and his age when he joined
summary: Young names Tizo Miller, Eddie Berg and Tweedlin' Beard and says he was fifteen or sixteen when he joined.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Lets go back and talk a little bit more about Chick Carter. How did you get in the band? Were you recommended?

Chick Carter‘s band, there was a lot of good guys in that band, came out of that band. Tizo Miller. Curtis Miller, he went with somebody else, Tizo. Eddie Berg on drums. You just remind of Eddie, something about you reminds me of Eddie Berg. He had a great smile, a great everything, but he could play man. [shoo] He could play. Eddie Berg. Tweedlin‘ Beard on bass. He got pretty good but I mean he didn‘t get all the way to the top, but he was very good; he should have, but he didn‘t. Not all good musicians didn‘t make it back in them days, you know what I‘m saying. Whole lot of people don‘t get on big time. I don‘t know why, but they should, but they don‘t, I can‘t explain that.
Do you remember how old you were when you joined Chick Carter‘s band? How old you were, how old?
Yes…because you left home, you said, in the tenth grade you left school.
I must have been, I went with Jimmie when I was nineteen, so I must have been fifteen or sixteen years old when I went with Chick.
